notes: Route B is built as ADR-0010 option C under ADR-0015, a working assumption pending confirmation by both PIs: QSVT eigenstate filtering for a Hermitian stoquastic operator. ADR-0010 records that the G-2 thresholds do not depend on this choice. Amendment 13 discloses that the first derivation of the degree omitted the initial-overlap term and overshot by factors of 3.3 to 7.2; the corrected form is the standard two-factor eigenstate-filtering cost and contains no fitted constant. The degree is linear in alpha over the gap, not square root: Chebyshev acceleration needs the target eigenvalue outside the encoded spectrum and here it is inside by construction.
